text:
deploy-bot: [INCIDENT] Canary service inference-gateway-canary reported spike in 5xx during deploy 2026.03.15-rc8. Error class: KMSError "AccessDenied" when retrieving secret /secrets/prod/inference/privkey. See alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/3301122334
oncall-lucy: paging @sre-jordan @eng-raj — canary 5xx up. I see KMS AccessDenied in pod logs. Taking lead.
sre-jordan: oncall — looking at traces, failures originate in secret fetch path at init time; stack: secretfetch->kms.Decrypt -> AccessDenied. Which key alias was involved?
eng-raj: I rotated alias alias/infrakey-2026-03 at 10:11 UTC as part of key hygiene. I updated secret to point to new key but forgot to attach kms:Decrypt to role svc-inference-deployer. Investigating.
oncall-lucy: impact note: canary only but mirrored sampling to prod shows ~1.5% increases in user-facing 500s. CS pinged.
cs-lina: got ~8 support hits referencing request id pattern r-ff9*; marking customers affected: acct-210, acct-449. Escalation P2.
infra-bot: KMS event: key rotation detected alias/infrakey-2026-03 by eng-raj at 2026-03-15T10:11:02Z; no IAM change to svc-inference-deployer role recorded.
sre-jordan: confirmed root cause hypothesis: role missing kms:Decrypt on new key material. Secret provider returns 403.
eng-raj: immediate plan: 1) stop rollout to remaining canary nodes. 2) flip feature flag to route traffic away from canary variant. 3) if needed, rollback.
product-kim: toggling flag: flags.inference.canary_use_new_kms -> OFF via Console now.
deploy-bot: Feature flag update acknowledged (flags.inference.canary_use_new_kms=OFF).
ops-max: pausing the canary pipeline: /pipeline pause inference-canary 2026.03.15-rc8
sre-jordan: mitigation option B: set SECRET_KMS_ALIAS env var to the previous alias on running pods so they can fetch using old key without waiting for IAM fix. Quick commands:
```
kubectl set env deploy/inference-gateway SECRET_KMS_ALIAS=alias/infrakey-2025 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-gateway -n prod
```
eng-raj: applying env fallback now. Pushing a hotfix patch to manifest repo as well.
ops-max: opening PR to add kms:Decrypt to svc-inference-deployer role: PR #4981. Attaching policy kms-decrypt-prod.
infra-bot: PR #4981 created by ops-max to add IAM policy kms-decrypt-prod to role svc-inference-deployer. Link: https://git.redwood.example/pr/4981
sre-jordan: if PR merges, we can re-run canary safely. Until then keep kill-switch engaged and monitor.
oncall-lucy: rollback path prepared if errors persist: /deploy rollback inference-gateway canary --to=2026.03.11-stable
eng-raj: initiating controlled rollback to stable as precaution. Rolling back 2/4 canary nodes now.
deploy-bot: Rollback command executed by eng-raj at 2026-03-15T10:17:50Z. Progress: 2/4 nodes reverted.
product-kim: coordinating customer comms with @cs-lina — please share short blurb confirming temporary interruption and we're restoring service.
cs-lina: sending interim note to affected orgs; adding status page update.
ops-max: remediation checklist being populated in incident doc: add IAM validation into deploy pipeline, add unit-test for key alias grant during rotations, add explicit preflight that validates secret fetch for canary nodes.
sre-jordan: post-mitigation check: after rollback + env-fallback + flag off, 5xx returned to baseline within 90s. Monitoring for recurrence.
infra-bot: log archive saved to incident bucket s3://incidents/3301122334/logs and traces pushed to jaeger trace://3301122334
oncall-lucy: handing over to night oncall @oncall-night for watch at 2026-03-15T10:25Z. Actions for oncall-night: watch metrics for 30m, ensure PR #4981 merges or revert plan exists.
eng-raj: follow-ups: 1) complete PR #4981 with test, 2) add deploy preflight check, 3) schedule a runbook update for KMS rotation.
sre-jordan: root cause summary: key rotation performed without granting decrypt to deploy role -> secret provider could not access key -> init secret fetch failed on canary -> 5xx spike. Mitigations: feature-flag kill-switch, env var fallback, immediate rollback, IAM PR.
product-kim: scheduled postmortem review 2026-03-16 11:00 PT. Owners: ops-max, eng-raj, sre-jordan.
cs-lina: confirmed customers notified; will coordinate follow-ups after RCA.
oncall-lucy: incident marked mitigated. Closing active pager but leaving channel open for postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:
